requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Implement advanced AI-driven productivity features and manageability solutions, including AI-assisted print, scan, and support workflows, to simplify business operations for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses the need for increased efficiency and ease of management for SMBs with limited IT resources. Differentiates HP Magellan from competitors.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with SMB portal and AI solution stack.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI-driven features are available at launch, demonstrably improve workflow efficiency, and are accessible via the SMB portal.
requirements.citation: Magellan MRD, Page 4, Page 7, Page 10, Page 11

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Design Magellan to deliver HP's lowest business TCO for SMB customers, minimizing intervention and ongoing costs over the product lifecycle.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a top priority for SMBs and a key differentiator in the market.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires sustainable components and efficient consumables management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO is calculated and benchmarked to be lower than previous HP models and key competitors.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Introduce a replaceable maintenance box that can be serviced by the customer, reducing the need for technician intervention and downtime.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses new SMB segment needs and pain points related to serviceability and maintenance costs.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, Supplies Quality, DVAR, Tech Reg
requirements.Dependencies: Design must ensure ease of replacement and clear instructions for end-users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by an end-user without technical assistance; validated via usability testing.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Printer Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal specifically for SMBs to manage all Magellan printers, including device status, usage analytics, and support access.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack dedicated IT staff and require simple, centralized management tools.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with AI solutions and Magellan device firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is live at launch, supports all required management functions, and is accessible to SMB users.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Consumables
requirements.Description: Utilize keyed bottles for ink and other consumables to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure compatibility with Magellan devices.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces consumable errors, minimizes service calls, and ensures product reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires redesign of consumable packaging and printer interface.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles are available at launch and are not interchangeable with previous models.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability Standards
requirements.Description: Provide a warranty of 80,000 pages or 2 years (whichever is first). Support customer-replaceable parts (PHA) and service center replaceable parts (MINK), with a target for more parts to be customer replaceable.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and increases customer satisfaction for SMBs with minimal IT support.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, Supplies Quality, DVAR, Tech Reg, Prod Steward
requirements.Dependencies: Design for serviceability and robust part supply chain.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are met and documented; at least 80% of identified serviceable parts are customer replaceable.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS and Non-PDL/PDL SKUs
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan supports Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) models and both Non-PDL and PDL SKUs, with specific speed and protocol support (PDL SKU: 25/20 ppm, PDL/PS support, Blue Angel compliance).
requirements.Rationale: Addresses diverse SMB needs and aligns with HP's strategic intent to expand service-based offerings.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, R&D Telemetry, Tech Reg
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware and hardware compatibility, compliance with Blue Angel and other standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Both SKU types available at launch, meet specified speed and compliance requirements.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Manufacture Magellan with at least 60% recycled content plastic, exceeding competitor benchmarks (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key differentiator and aligns with HP's environmental goals.
requirements.Dependencies: Supply chain and material sourcing for RCP.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product BOM and external certification confirm at least 60% RCP.

requirements.Title: Advanced Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Integrate telemetry features to monitor device health, usage, and proactively support SMB customers through the portal and AI solutions.
requirements.Rationale: Enables predictive maintenance, reduces downtime, and provides valuable insights for SMBs and HP support teams.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with SMB portal and AI stack.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is available in real-time via the portal and supports proactive support interventions.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing capabilities through the HP App, supporting key SMB use cases for on-the-go printing and management.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses modern SMB needs for flexibility and remote work support.
requirements.Dependencies: App integration with Magellan firmware and SMB portal.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing is available, reliable, and user-friendly at launch.
